params.text: This turn rebuilt the bakery site in Vite + React + TypeScript (replacing the earlier plain-JS build) and added a working order system. app/dist now has five static pages: index, menu, about, visit and the new order page. The basket lives in localStorage, the header badge follows it, and checkout produces a numbered confirmation with pay-at-pickup (no online payment or order delivery to the bakery — open question unk_9fa30d5afcc67a29). Brand placeholder 'Hearth & Crumb' and warm artisan style were kept because no real name/style was given (unknowns unk_753a122cc72f977f, unk_ab833bb9e2ac0722). npm run build passes; rebuild_check says 'build: passed' with no visual comparison possible because there is no original target. A scripted browser run placed an order successfully (ev_751684569ed1383122c621cca5b0bda40a7ce6d9e42ad38c01ad120f6c5930ce). The only console noise is a favicon.ico 404, harmless. Trap: an old vite.config.js shadowed the new vite.config.ts and had to be deleted; keep only the TS config. Environment: node/npm at C:\Program Files\nodejs; build via the Craft Anything build runner in app/. Next useful step: ask the person for the real bakery name/style and whether they want real payment or orders emailed to them.
